features.title: name hash
features.description: FNV-1a 64 of a wire format or framing name, as the handshake carries it

features.title: handshake
features.description: the fixed 31-byte frame each side sends first: magic, version, IR hash, wire format, framing, capabilities

features.title: envelope
features.description: a response's outcome: ok with a payload, an error ordinal with its body, or a provider fault

features.title: datagram framing
features.description: Comline's own binary framing of requests and responses

features.title: datagram@2 framing
features.description: the datagram framing with a request/reply kind and a protocol number, for calls in both directions and several protocols on one connection

features.title: datagram@3 framing
features.description: the datagram framing that addresses a call by its protocol's and function's wire numbers, both varints (calls = by_id); replies as datagram@2

features.title: comline@2 handshake
features.description: the compatibility-checking handshake: its hello, answer and verdict messages, and its negotiation steps under every parameter, with every refusal reason

features.title: stream framing
features.description: frames on a byte stream (TCP, a pipe): each behind a u32 little-endian length prefix, refused over the limit, by default 16 MiB (16777216 bytes) in every runtime

features.title: JSON-RPC framing
features.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 requests and responses, a fault as -32603

features.title: JSON wire format
features.description: values as UTF-8 JSON: a struct as an object

features.title: MessagePack wire format
features.description: values as MessagePack: a struct as an array

features.title: packed wire format
features.description: values as packed@1: fixed-width fields back to back, varint lengths, no tags

features.title: packed sizes
features.description: how many bytes each kind of value takes in packed@1, each rule proven by values written to exactly its minimum and maximum

features.title: MessagePack sizes
features.description: how many bytes each kind of value takes in msgpack@1, each rule proven by values written to exactly its minimum and maximum

features.title: JSON sizes
features.description: how many bytes each kind of value takes in json@1, each rule proven by values written to exactly its minimum and maximum, or by a declared upper bound
